# mailboxorg_domain (Data Source)

Looks up a domain known to mailbox.org (`domain.get`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mailboxorg_domain" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

output "context_id" {
  value = data.mailboxorg_domain.example.context_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `context_id` (String) Context (cloud office) ID the domain belongs to.
- `date_register` (String) Registration date as reported by the API.
- `id` (String) The domain name.
- `memo` (String) Free-text memo.
- `plans_available` (List of String) Mailbox plans available for this domain.
- `status` (String) Domain status as reported by the API.
